sections.description: The accessible name of the menu beside the appearance settings, which lists their sections: the color palette, the modifiers.

palette.description: The section of the appearance settings that sets the site's colors: its name in the menu beside the settings, and the heading over its form.

paletteHint.defaultMessage: Each color is drawn out into every shade the site uses. Pick one of the theme’s colors, or type a hex code.
paletteHint.description: The line under the heading of the color palette of the appearance settings: how a color is set, and what setting it does.

modifiers.description: The section of the appearance settings that sets what a visitor starts with, the color scheme, the contrast, the text size and the like: its name in the menu beside the settings, and the heading over its form.

modifiersHint.defaultMessage: What a visitor starts with, until they choose their own.
modifiersHint.description: The line under the heading of the modifiers of the appearance settings: whom they apply to.

primary.description: The label of the field for the site's primary color, and the name of that color among the theme's.

secondary.description: The label of the field for the site's secondary color, and the name of that color among the theme's.

tertiary.description: The label of the field for the site's tertiary color, and the name of that color among the theme's.

error.description: The label of the field for the color the site says something went wrong in, and the name of that color among the theme's.

success.description: The label of the field for the color the site says something went well in, and the name of that color among the theme's.

warning.description: The label of the field for the color the site warns in, and the name of that color among the theme's.

neutral.description: The label of the field for the grey of the site's surfaces and text, and the name of that color among the theme's.

neutralVariant.description: The label of the field for the grey of the site's outlines, and the name of that color among the theme's.

themeColors.description: The accessible name of the row of the theme's own colors under a color field, any of which may be picked for it.

pick.description: The accessible name of one of the theme's own colors, a button that sets the field to it. `name` is the color's name among the theme's, and `hex` its hex code.

notFound.defaultMessage: The appearance settings could not be found.
notFound.description: What the appearance settings say when there is nothing stored to change.
